**On the Gram determinants of the Specht modules**

*Lehrstuhl für Algebra und Zahlentheorie, RWTH Aachen University*

19 pp, 3 sections.

**Abstract.** For every partitionλ of a positive integern, letSλ be the corresponding Specht module of the symmetric group Sn, and let det(λ)∈ Z denote the Gram determinant of the canonical bilinear form with respect to the standard basis ofSλ. Writing det(λ) = m· 2a(2) λ for integersa(2) λ andm withm odd, we show that if the dimension ofSλ is even, thena(2) λ is also even. This confirms a conjecture posed by Richard Parker in the special case of the symmetric groups.

**Outline.** Introduction; Preliminaries; Proof of Theorem 1.1
